title: Maximal entropy production principle and the Euler system of gas dynamics
summary: Convex integration has revealed that the Euler system of gas dynamics is ill-posed in the class of weak solutions even if the entropy inequality is imposed as an additional constraint. A natural question arises, namely, if a physically relevant solution can be selected by maximizing the entropy production rate. Firstly, we present an example of Riemann initial data in 2-D, for which the standard self-similar solution fails to satisfy the maximal entropy production principle.
